description: Static `<md>` heading ids are slugs, deduped page-wide in document order against every author `id=` and every earlier heading (`-1`, `-2`, …); non-Latin letters are kept.
provenance: PA direction, s462-md-phase1 review (§67.6 Heading ids)
rationale: §67.6: every heading of a static `<md>` gets a GitHub-style slug; a slug already used on the page (by another heading or an author `id=`) gets the first free `-1`, `-2`, … suffix, in document order; Unicode letters are kept.
